description: This file defines classes and functions for managing XPU streams and events in PyTorch, including stream synchronization, event recording, and device management.

classes.name: Stream
classes.description: Wrapper around a XPU stream, supporting synchronization and event recording.

classes.name: Event
classes.description: Wrapper around a XPU event, used for synchronization and timing.

methods.name: wait_event
methods.description: Make all future work submitted to the stream wait for an event.

methods.name: record_event
methods.description: Record an event in the stream.

methods.name: query
methods.description: Check if all work in the stream or event has been completed.

methods.name: synchronize
methods.description: Wait for all kernels in the stream or event to complete.

methods.name: elapsed_time
methods.description: Return the time elapsed between two events.
